## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test -- --run`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Review checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation for command, configuration, or behavior changes.
- [ ] I assessed authentication, authorization, privacy, and secret-handling impact.
- [ ] I did not include real student data, credentials, or production secrets.
- [ ] I documented any data/schema migration and its rollback path, or this change has no migration.
- [ ] I called out deployment or environment-variable changes.
